item.title: Hitler’s Final Agile Planning Meeting
item.dc:creator: Jesper Rønn-Jensen
item.description:
It all ends with the fatal Iteration#6 — at least according to this video a colleague pointed me to.

Video clip is taken from “The Downfall” and texted as if we were attending a daily scrum meeting during world war II.
